title: 'Congress leaders in Punjab must break silence': Sukhbir Badal on Sonia Gandhi's 'clean chit' to 'killers of Sikhs'
Late-arriving grooms put on notice as Kashmir's wedding chefs set 10 pm deadline for wazwan
summary: Kashmir's wedding chefs, known as waza, have unanimously decided to stop serving food after 10 pm. They have cited long working hours and poor treatment as reasons for this decision. Working conditions have become difficult due to extended delays from guests, particularly the groom's arrival. Chefs…
